Name: Adoni-bezek
Summary: Adoni-bezek was a Canaanite king captured at Bezek by Judah and Simeon; after his thumbs and great toes were cut off, he acknowledged that God had repaid him as he had done to seventy kings, and he died at Jerusalem.
KeyStory: Judah and Simeon found Adoni-bezek at Bezek, cut off his thumbs and great toes, and brought him to Jerusalem, where he died.
LifeLesson: A king who once mutilated others met the same measure himself — and owned it as God's repayment.
